'''Voltfawn''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Sparkdoe]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "No matter how powerful the foes may be, Voltfawn never yields, serving diligently under the revered [[Zapantler]]."

Voltfawn is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, orange, white, and yellow deer with curved cylindrical magnets as antlers. Each antler is colored at the tip in blue (magnetic north pole) or red (magnetic south pole).

Voltfawn's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow with cyan. The colors of the magnetic poles on its antlers remain the same.

== Evolution Trial ==
Voltfawn's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Sparkdoe]] you need to complete the following task:
* Kill 300 [[Zobos]] while clearing stages.

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "Voltfawn is just getting started. Beating Zobos makes it feel younger and more energetic."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Fresh out of college, Voltfawn is young, energetic, and cheerful, fighting Zobos without being told to, without tiring."

==Strategy==
[[File:Voltfawn Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Voltfawn's attack range]]
Voltfawn's ability to paralyze Zobos gives your other Tatari a chance to deal critical damage.
